name: King Arthur
subtitle: Lord of Camelot
description: Stalwart protector that’s capable of retaliating often while protecting allies.
lore: The Once and Future King has returned, yet he has not accomplished what many expected. Though he rules a portion of Avalon, he has made no move to unite its disparate domains, nor has he launched attacks against the Realm’s enemies. Whether his recalcitrance is due to the Morrigan’s other plans, or his own unspoken ambitions or fears, remains an oft-debated question.
divinity_generator: Gain [100] Divinity when this hero counterattacks.

Awaken the ability: Blessing of the Grail

skills.name: Excaliburs Call
skills.description: Attack all enemies (210%DEF+120%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] and [mechanic:init-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Blessing of the Grail
skills.description: When this hero [Intercept's] attacks, reduce the damage taken by 50% and 10%HP this hero.

skills.name: Loyal Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (260%DEF+140%ATK). Place [mechanic:intercept] on the ally with the Highest INIT for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Additionally, place [Intercept] on allies from Avalon for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kings Oath
skills.description: Place [mechanic:ward] for 2 turns on this hero then place [mechanic:vanish] on all allies for 2 turns. Also has a 80% chance to place [mechanic:taunt] on all enemies for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: When an ally under [Vanish] is attacked, reduce the damage received by 25% and increase this hero’s Divinity by 5%.
